issues.issue: Whether the appellant is a member of a particular social group of vulnerable Haitian women.
issues.applicant_position: She is a vulnerable Haitian woman, a particular social group recognized by the Federal Court.
issues.result_text: Appellant has a well-founded fear of persecution as a member of the particular social group.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in its overall credibility assessment of the appellant.
issues.applicant_position: Trauma explains the confusion; the RPD's findings are wrong and her account is credible.
issues.result_text: RPD erred in its credibility analysis; the appellant is credible on central allegations.

issues.issue: Whether omissions from her written account undermine her credibility.
issues.applicant_position: Omissions are not fatal to the claim.
issues.result_text: RAD does not accept the identified omissions as significant enough to undermine credibility.

issues.issue: Whether her conduct after the events undermines her fear.
issues.applicant_position: She returned to earn money under spousal pressure; fear of staying in the US explains not regularizing status.
issues.result_text: Her behaviour is explained by her circumstances and does not undermine her main allegations.

issues.issue: Whether adequate state protection is available in Haiti.
issues.result_text: Presumption of state protection is rebutted; no adequate protection exists in Haiti.

issues.issue: Whether an internal flight alternative is reasonable for the appellant.
issues.applicant_position: She fears persecution in other areas, and her vulnerable state makes relocation unreasonable.
issues.result_text: Given her situation and vulnerable state of mind, an internal flight alternative would not be reasonable.
